unsupported_message:
I received your {message_type}, but this procurement flow works best with typed text right now.

Please type your reply as text so I can keep helping you. You can also send 0 to return to the main menu.
main_menu:
Welcome to SocioMED!

What medical supply do you need today? You may type a product immediately.

1. Search products
2. Browse categories
3. Request a quotation
4. Talk to sales
0. Main menu

Type END at any time to close this session.
help:
How SocioMED works:
1. Search a product such as surgical gloves or oxygen mask.
2. View featured offers when you want a quick shortlist.
3. Request a quotation and we shall notify the sales team to follow up.
4. Talk to sales for urgent or complex sourcing needs.
5. Browse by category when you want to scan product families first.

Use 0 at any time to return to the main menu, or END to close the session.
direct_rfq_prompt:
Reply with your RFQ in one message: your name, then item(s), quantity, facility, and delivery location.

Single item:
Dr. Ali | surgical gloves | 10 | Mulago Hospital | Kampala

Bulk list:
Dr. Ali | gloves x10, catheters x5, IV sets x20 | Mulago Hospital | Kampala
no_featured_offers: No featured offers are available right now. Reply 1 to search the catalog.
featured_offer:
{index}. {product_name} - {brand} from {vendor_name}
From {price_text} per {uom} | Stock {stock_qty} | Lead time {lead_time_days} days
featured_footer: Reply with the product name you want to search, or reply 3 to request a quotation.
no_categories: No catalog categories are available right now. Reply 1 to search directly or 3 to request a quotation.
categories_footer:
Reply with the category number or exact category name.
Use 0 at any time to return to the main menu.
category_empty:
We do not have products listed in {category_name} yet.
Reply with another category number, or use 0 to return to the main menu.
category_products_overflow: Type the exact product name if you do not see it in the numbered list.
category_products_footer:
Reply with the product number you want to price first, or type the exact product name.
Use 0 at any time to return to the main menu.
related_footer: Reply with R1, R2, or R3 to view that related item.
message_too_long: Please send a shorter message using normal text, numbers, and punctuation.
search_prompt: What medical supply are you looking for?
sales_prompt_short: Reply with: Name | Organization | What you need. We will connect you directly with a salesperson.
sales_prompt:
Reply with: Name | Organization | What you need.
Example: Amina | City Care Hospital | Need 500 pairs of gloves urgently
restricted_medicine: SocioMED handles medical supplies and equipment, not medicines. Type the supply item you need, or reply SALES for help.
returning_rfq:
Welcome back, {first_name}. Reply item | quantity to reuse {organization} and {delivery_location}, or use the full format to change them.

{prompt}
entry_fallback: Type a medical supply, QUOTE for a formal request, CATEGORIES to browse, or SALES for help. Reply MENU to see all options.
bulk_detected: This looks like a multi-item sourcing list, so we should capture it as one RFQ for manual routing.
bulk_complex: This looks like a larger bulk sourcing list, so a SocioMED agent should triage it as one RFQ.
search_invalid: Please enter a clear product search such as surgical gloves, IV set, or oxygen mask.
search_no_match:
I could not find that exact product.

Reply SEARCH to try another term, or SALES for help.
search_no_live_offer_menu: We found the product, but there is no validated live price for it right now. Reply 3 from the main menu and SocioMED can source a quotation.
sales_handoff_prompt:
Reply with: name | organization | what you need.
We will connect you directly with a salesperson.
disambiguation_invalid: Please reply with one of the product numbers shown, RFQ for a manual quotation, or AGENT for sales.
search_no_live_offer_rfq:
We found the product, but there is no validated live price for it right now.
Reply RFQ to request a manual quotation, or AGENT for a sourcing handoff.
category_invalid: Please reply with one of the category numbers shown, or type the exact category name.
category_product_invalid: Please reply with one of the product numbers shown, or type the exact product name from that category.
category_no_live_offer:
We found the product, but there is no validated live price for it right now.
Reply with another product number, type another product name, or use 3 from the main menu to request a quotation.
related_invalid: That related item is not available. Reply with an offer number or 0 for menu.
related_missing: That related item is no longer available. Reply 0 for the main menu.
related_no_live_offer: We do not have a validated live offer for that related item right now.
offer_number_prompt: Reply with the offer number you want, or 0 for the main menu.
offer_invalid: That option is not available. Reply with one of the offer numbers shown.
quantity_integer: Please reply with a quantity as a whole number.
quantity_positive: Please reply with a quantity greater than zero.
quantity_below_minimum: Minimum order for this offer is {minimum_quantity} {uom}.
price_menu:
Estimated starting price: {price_text} per {uom}.

Reply with:
1. Request quotation
2. Talk to sales
3. Back to search results
0. Main menu

Type END if you are finished.

Reply with your name, facility/client name, and delivery location.
Example: Dr. Ali, Mulago Hospital, Kampala

{routing_message}

If you are finished, reply END to close this session.

Your quotation request has been logged as RFQ #{rfq_id}.
Our team will match it to suppliers and follow up with you.

If you are finished, reply END to close this session.
sales_handoff_error: We could not hand this off to sales right now. Please try again shortly.
sales_handoff_received:
Your request has been shared with our sales team. Lead #{lead_id} is now open and someone will reach out shortly.

If you are finished, reply END to close this session.
unknown_state: I did not understand that. Reply 0 for the main menu.
conversation_closed: Thank you for contacting SocioMED. This session is now closed. You can message us again at any time to start a new request.
worker_failure: Sorry, I could not complete that request right now. Your message has not been ignored. Please try again shortly, or reply 4 from the main menu to contact sales.
results_empty: No options available. Type 0 to return to the menu.
results_header:
*{product_name} – Available Options*

Reply with the offer number you want to request.
result_availability: Min qty: {min_qty} {uom} | Availability: {availability} | Indicative lead time: {lead_time_days} days
ambiguous_next_large:
Reply with the product number to price one item first.
Reply RFQ if this is a bulk request, or AGENT for a sourcing handoff.
ambiguous_next_small: Reply with the product number you want to price first. Reply RFQ for a manual quotation, or AGENT for sales.
buyer_status_confirmed: Good news — your order (RFQ #{rfq_id}) for {product_name} is confirmed. The supplier is preparing it and we'll follow up with delivery details shortly.
buyer_status_fulfilled: Your order (RFQ #{rfq_id}) for {product_name} has been fulfilled. Thank you for sourcing through SocioMED — reply 1 any time to start your next order, or END to close the session.
